adapters.name: openai_whisper_tiny
adapters.command: bash -lc 'python3 scripts/run_whisper_streaming.py --manifest {input_manifest} --model tiny --device cpu --output runs/final/asr_commands/raw/whisper_tiny_raw.jsonl && python3 scripts/export_streaming_transcript.py --schema whisper --manifest {input_manifest} --raw runs/final/asr_commands/raw/whisper_tiny_raw.jsonl --output {output}'

adapters.name: funasr_paraformer
adapters.command: bash -lc 'python3 scripts/run_funasr_streaming.py --manifest {input_manifest} --model paraformer-zh --device cpu --output runs/final/asr_commands/raw/funasr_paraformer_raw.jsonl && python3 scripts/export_streaming_transcript.py --schema funasr --manifest {input_manifest} --raw runs/final/asr_commands/raw/funasr_paraformer_raw.jsonl --output {output}'

adapters.name: whisper_cpp_quantized
adapters.command: bash -lc 'python3 scripts/run_whisper_cpp_streaming.py --manifest {input_manifest} --binary whisper-cli --model models/whisper.cpp/ggml-tiny.bin --output runs/final/asr_commands/raw/whisper_cpp_raw.jsonl && python3 scripts/export_streaming_transcript.py --schema whisper_cpp --manifest {input_manifest} --raw runs/final/asr_commands/raw/whisper_cpp_raw.jsonl --output {output}'
